subject: council.yassin_local_execution.boundary
summary: YASSIN local execution is being split into two bounded capabilities: Windows MCP for constrained GUI/QA automation and YASSIN Verified Files for SHA-backed source/file edits plus authorized shell/process work; the replacement is prepared but not yet runtime-accepted because the private YASSIN tunnel is currently terminated.

details.windows_mcp_role: screen, interaction, apps and testing only with dangerous tools explicitly excluded
details.verified_files_role: verified source/file mutations and authorized command/process lifecycle
details.local_blocker: YASSIN Verified Files returns Session terminated
details.motion_boundary: Windows MCP session recording is not W1.1 acceptance evidence; governed 30fps WGC remains authoritative
